en: After confirmation, send one request and wait for an actual window. The background engine will not restart automatically.
source: 确认后只发送一次请求，并等待实际窗口；不会自动重启后台核心。

en: {0} has {1} windows. Choose a window for this action: {2}.
source: {0} 有 {1} 个窗口，请选择要{2}的窗口。

en: {0} has {1} hidden main windows to try. Choose one; Process Keeper will request visibility and verify the result. The app may hide its window again.
source: {0} 有 {1} 个可尝试恢复的隐藏主窗口。选择窗口后，Process Keeper会请求显示并检查实际结果。程序可能自行再次隐藏窗口。

en: This process has no restorable window or supported view. A background service may have no UI.
source: 此进程没有可恢复窗口或已支持的界面入口。纯后台服务可能没有页面。

en: No visible window can be minimized. Refresh the list.
source: 当前没有可最小化的可见窗口，请刷新状态。

en: Preview paused | Browser is still running
source: 画面已暂停 | 原浏览器仍在运行

en: A headless Android emulator is running without a native main window.
source: 检测到 headless 安卓模拟器核心，目前没有可恢复的原生主窗口。

en: A window is on another virtual desktop or hidden by Windows. Switch to its desktop first; only existing main windows on this desktop can be restored here.
source: 检测到其他虚拟桌面或被系统隐藏的窗口，请先切换到对应桌面。此处只能恢复当前桌面上已经存在的普通主窗口。

en: The selected AVD will close and restart. Running tasks will be interrupted; save your work first.
source: 将退出并重新启动所选 AVD。正在运行的任务会中断，请先保存。

en: Use Restart AVD with native window and confirm the restart. Embedded views may also be available in Android Studio's Running Devices.
source: 可使用“以原生窗口重启 AVD”，确认后自动重新启动。嵌入 Android Studio 的窗口也可从 Running Devices 查看。

en: No verifiable device was found. Refresh and try again.
source: 没有找到可核实的设备，请刷新后重试。

en: No restorable main window was found. Background services may have no UI; tray apps may need their tray icon to recreate a window. Open the app through its own entry point, then refresh.
source: 没有找到可恢复的主窗口。后台服务和辅助进程可能从未创建界面；托盘程序也可能需要点击托盘图标重新创建窗口。请先从程序自身的入口打开页面，再刷新列表。
其他桌面 / 系统隐藏

en: The app may have been removed or moved, or its location is inaccessible. Refresh the list.
source: 软件可能已卸载、移动或路径不可访问，请刷新列表。

en: No exit or launch request was sent.
source: 尚未发送退出或启动请求。

en: No valid page image was displayed. See the preview window for details.
source: 未获取并显示有效页面图像，详情见预览窗口。

en: No accessible file path. Scan Installed apps to locate an app that is not running.
source: 未找到可访问的文件路径；未运行的规则可先在已安装应用页扫描软件。

en: No restorable Android emulator main window was found.
source: 未找到可恢复的安卓模拟器主窗口。
无头页面实时画面 | Process Keeper

en: Show a read-only live preview of the existing headless page. Its task keeps running; closing the preview only disconnects the view.
source: 显示原无头页面的只读实时画面。原任务继续运行；关闭预览只断开画面连接。

en: Keep the original device directory and runtime options, and cold-start with a native window.
source: 沿用原设备目录和运行参数，改为原生窗口冷启动。

en: The page image could not be decoded.
Possible native AVD view. Its identity and visibility will be verified before success is reported.
source: 已识别为 AVD 原生设备页面候选；显示前仍会重新核实，不代表已经打开成功。

en: Remaining steps were cancelled. Windows already opened stay open.
source: 已停止后续操作；已经打开的窗口保留。

en: A read-only live preview of the existing page is open in a separate window.
source: 已在独立窗口显示原页面的只读实时画面。

en: AVD native restart confirmed | {0} | Original PID {1} | Port {2}
source: 用户确认 AVD 原生窗口重启 | {0} | 原 PID {1} | 端口 {2}
用户确认无头页面预览 | PID {0}
用户确认专用界面 | {0} | PID {1}

en: The preview window has no visible display area.
source: 预览窗口没有可见的画面区域。
正在读取并核验真实图像…
正在读取真实页面图像…

en: Verifying the device and launch options. The emulator will stay running until you confirm.
source: 正在核实设备和启动方式，确认前不会退出模拟器。

en: Checking available views for the selected process…
source: 正在核实所选进程的可用方式…

en: Read-only live view | {0:HH:mm:ss} | Closing the preview keeps the browser running
source: 只读实时画面 | {0:HH:mm:ss} | 关闭预览不会关闭原浏览器

en: AVD restart cancelled | No exit or launch request was sent.
source: AVD 重启已取消 | 尚未发送退出或启动请求。

en: MyDock service: skipped because its install path changed or could not be verified.
source: MyDock 服务：安装路径已改变或无法核实，已跳过。

en: MyDock service: skipped because its configuration does not match the confirmed path or cannot be verified.
source: MyDock 服务：打开后的服务配置与确认路径不一致或无法核实，已跳过。

en: MyDock service: skipped because it is not accepting stop requests.
source: MyDock 服务：当前不接受停止请求，已跳过。

en: MyDock service: skipped because its configuration changed.
source: MyDock 服务：服务配置发生变化，已跳过。

en: MyDock service: could not open. Run as administrator.
source: MyDock 服务：无法打开，请以管理员权限运行。

en: MyDock service: skipped because its dependencies could not be verified.
source: MyDock 服务：无法核实依赖，已跳过。

en: MyDock service: skipped because its running state could not be verified.
source: MyDock 服务：无法核实运行状态，已跳过。

en: MyDock service: stop requested, but not yet confirmed.
source: MyDock 服务：已发送停止请求，但尚未确认停止。
MyDock 服务：已经处于停止过程中。

en: MyDock service: skipped because other running services depend on it.
source: MyDock 服务：有其他运行中的依赖服务，已跳过。
